questions.question: Use highlight_category with field equal to Species, highlight_category with values equal to Iris-virginica to compare the difference of Iris-virginica with the other two species.

answer.value: Iris-virginica has the highest values for petal length and petal width. Its sepal length is also the longest among the three species, while sepal width is moderate.
